description: This Python module defines functions and classes for loading, managing, and accessing prebuilt regex patterns used for content filtering, specifically for detecting sensitive information such as SSNs, credit cards, and API keys. It dynamically loads pattern data from a JSON file, creates enums and lookup dictionaries, and provides functions to retrieve patterns and metadata.

classes.name: PrebuiltPatternName
classes.description: Enum class for prebuilt pattern names, dynamically generated from JSON data.

methods.name: _load_patterns_from_json
methods.description: Loads pattern definitions from patterns.json file.

methods.name: get_compiled_pattern
methods.description: Returns a compiled regex pattern object for a given pattern name.

methods.name: get_all_pattern_names
methods.description: Returns a list of all available prebuilt pattern names.

methods.name: get_pattern_metadata
methods.description: Provides metadata for all patterns for UI display.

methods.name: get_available_content_categories
methods.description: Returns a list of available content categories from YAML files for UI display.
